items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: I took lessons from Vic... he really helped me quite a lot.

ctx.x: Do I remember Vic Lebowski? Oh, I took lessons from Vic. After I left Mrs. Asap, as I told you, I began just going out on my own, you know, and learning the jazz tunes and learning how to play jazz. But then after a couple of years I realized that I should improve a little bit on my technique and knowledge of music. So I started taking lessons from Vic, and I took about six months from him, and he really helped me quite a lot. But I never, I just couldn't get away from the unorthodox playing. In fact, Vic used to…
Vic was a kind of a legitimate guy?
